bias.en: Rebound pausing · gap partly filled, back under $263.9
bias.zh: 反弹暂停 · 缺口部分回补，跌回 $263.9 下方

read.en: Amazon fell 2.2% on Nov 5 to $260.21, trading $252.32–273.23 on 1.8 times its 20-day average volume. It holds above the rising 5-day ($252.58), the falling 10-day ($251.15) and 30-day ($253.39), and the rising 100-day ($252.38) and 200-day ($243.82). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 4 and is just above zero; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Nov 4 ($230.20), and RSI is 55.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月5日下跌 2.2%，收于 $260.21，盘中区间 $252.32–273.23，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.8 倍。股价仍位于上行的 5 日均线（$252.58）、下行的 10 日（$251.15）和 30 日均线（$253.39）以及上行的 100 日（$252.38）和 200 日均线（$243.82）上方。MACD 于 11月4日上穿信号线，略高于零轴；抛物线 SAR 于 11月4日转为看多（$230.20），RSI 为 55。

read.en: The $273.23 high cleared the Aug 28 high but faded, and the close lost the $263.9–265.3 support (Nov 4 low, Oct 20 high), now resistance; the low filled most of the Nov 4 gap but held the averages. Resistance is $263.9–265.3, then $271.5–273.2 (Nov 4–5 highs) and $287.2 (Aug 3 high). Support is $257–259.5, then $251.2–253.4 (5, 10, 30 and 100-day) and $243.8 (200-day). A close above $265.3 would target $271.5–273; below $251, $244.

s.en: Aug 21 low $257.0; Jul 16 high $258.1; Sep 21 high $259.5
